title: Approvals inbox: the sticky Approve / Reject column covers the Submitted column, and the Record column cuts record names short at common desktop widths
body:
repo:hotcrm#2 · sunhaolin · session_local1adc6fb3954245ba8940a3719cdaea98

Filing gate: ① product defect with a reproduction. Source: fleet (found in a maintainer-ordered local UI test pass of the HotCRM app on 2026-11-26; filed through the pm-dispatch relay on the maintainer's instruction).
Grading: area:ux · Bug · p2 (triage grades) · severity: Impeded · reach: every approver using the inbox at a window width around 1100 px or narrower · evidence: measured on the released 18.6.0 packages (2026-11-18), zh-CN console; not re-measured on main

## 维护者速读
- 做什么：审批收件箱在常见窗口宽度下，记录名和提交时间要能看全。
- 谁受益：每天在收件箱里批单的经理。
- 不做会怎样：记录名被截成「Polar Cargo – R…」，提交时间被右侧的通过/拒绝按钮列盖住，分不清在批哪一单、等了多久。
- 需要你做的：无，分诊定级即可。

## What

The approvals inbox table keeps the Approve / Reject column sticky on the right. At a content width of 928 px and of 1102 px:

- the Record column shows names cut short ("Polar Cargo – R…"; cell `clientWidth` 112 against `scrollWidth` 171), with no tooltip;
- the Submitted column's header and values are partly under the sticky action column.

Both hold in English and in zh-CN. The two things an approver decides on, which record and how long it has waited, are the two that are cut.

## Reproduction

1. With at least one pending request assigned to you, open the approvals inbox in a window about 1100 px wide.
2. Result: the record name ends in an ellipsis and the Submitted column is covered on its right side by the action column.

## Acceptance

- At widths of 928 px and above, the record name is readable in full (wrapping or a wider column), and a cut name carries a tooltip with the full text.
- The sticky action column never overlaps another column's content; the table scrolls horizontally or drops lower-priority columns instead.
- A layout test covers 928 px and 1102 px.

Dedupe (open and closed): `approvals inbox truncat`, `approvals inbox sticky column` 0 hits.
Batch-of: local UI deep test pass 2026-11-26, 14 cards (5 in hotcrm, 9 in objectstack).
Blocked-by: none.
